# Cosmical

Cosmical gives Obsidian a code-editor-inspired look with a neutral background and several built-in color schemes. Ocean, Forest, Twilight, Sunset and Night palettes are selectable, and Style Settings switches subthemes and toggles colored headings, file title visibility, the sidebar button and improved multi-select.

![Cosmical screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-torrus/obsidian-cosmical-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Cosmical"
    author: "m-torrus"
    repo:   "m-torrus/obsidian-cosmical-theme"
    slug:   "cosmical"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/cosmical"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/m-torrus/obsidian-cosmical-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-torrus/obsidian-cosmical-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Give Obsidian a balanced, code-editor-inspired look with a neutral background and vibrant built-in color schemes. Select palettes (Ocean, Forest, Twilight, Sunset, Night) and toggle UI touches like colored headings, file title visibility, sidebar button, and improved multi-select; use Style Settings to switch subthemes."
}
```
